methods_quotes.q: To compare differences by age, Pearson’s chi-square p-values were calculated.
standardized mean differences (SMDs) were calculated among age groups
Logistic regression was used to estimate measures of association of age group with nontreatment, adjusting for sex, race, ethnicity, comorbidity index, and ADI score.
a sensitivity analysis was conducted, excluding patients whose only index date was based on an antiviral prescription
